title: The Puppet That Refused to Bow
central_conflict: the wooden puppet leaned backward whenever the finale called for a bow
decisive_choice: a heavy replacement hat moved the puppet's balance behind its shoulders
resolution: lightened the hat and adjusted the strings until the puppet bowed
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the wooden puppet leaned backward whenever the finale called for a bow before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they shortened its strings but it tipped backward even faster; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a heavy replacement hat moved the puppet's balance behind its shoulders; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they lightened the hat and adjusted the strings until the puppet bowed, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Costumes That Changed Color
central_conflict: the theater troupe arrived wearing costumes that seemed to be the wrong colors
decisive_choice: the new colored stage lights were hiding the dyes' appearance under white light
resolution: checked every outfit in neutral lighting and relabeled the costume rack

title: The Pots That Cracked Before the Fair
central_conflict: the pottery stall's newest bowls cracked during their first firing
decisive_choice: the thick clay bases had retained moisture that expanded as steam
resolution: dried a test batch thoroughly before firing and remade the damaged bowls
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the pottery stall's newest bowls cracked during their first firing before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they lowered the furnace temperature but the next bowls still split; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the thick clay bases had retained moisture that expanded as steam; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they dried a test batch thoroughly before firing and remade the damaged bowls, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
